#Module webcodecs_image

WebCodecs ImageDecoder (src/page/bindings_image_decoder.odin, native/js/runtime/web_webcodecs_image.c). The decode is native: the host decodes the encoded bytes once with src/images (every frame composed) and wraps each frame as a VideoFrame. The engine holds the ImageDecoder wrapper, builds the ImageDecoderInit dictionary, resolves decode()'s and completed's promises, and exposes the ImageTrackList / ImageTrack. One track (the primary image) is exposed.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/webcodecs_image.widl.

Odin: import "wren:webcodecs".

#Types

#handle ImageDecoder : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_ImageDecoder).

#handle ImageTrackList : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_ImageTrackList).

#handle ImageTrack : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_ImageTrack).

#Functions

#ImageDecoder_create

ImageDecoder ImageDecoder_create(bytes data, string mime, bool prefer_animation) raises

new ImageDecoder({data, type, ...}): data is the encoded bytes (a BufferSource; the engine also reads a Blob or a ReadableStream to bytes first), mime the type option. Quota past the image limits / page memory, Type for empty data, Not_Supported when WebCodecs is off.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ImageDecoder_create :: proc(c: ^Call, data: []u8, mime: string, prefer_animation: bool) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#ImageDecoder_isTypeSupported

bool ImageDecoder_isTypeSupported(string mime)

ImageDecoder.isTypeSupported(type): honest — true only for a format we decode (not SVG).

Host: ImageDecoder_isTypeSupported :: proc(c: ^Call, mime: string) -> bool

#ImageDecoder_type

string ImageDecoder_type(ImageDecoder decoder)

decoder.type.

Host: ImageDecoder_type :: proc(c: ^Call, decoder: Api_ImageDecoder) -> string

#ImageDecoder_complete

bool ImageDecoder_complete(ImageDecoder decoder)

decoder.complete: the bytes are all available (always true for a BufferSource / Blob).

Host: ImageDecoder_complete :: proc(c: ^Call, decoder: Api_ImageDecoder) -> bool

#ImageDecoder_frameCount

u32 ImageDecoder_frameCount(ImageDecoder decoder)

The decoded frame count (0 before a successful decode).

Host: ImageDecoder_frameCount :: proc(c: ^Call, decoder: Api_ImageDecoder) -> u32

#ImageDecoder_decode

VideoFrame ImageDecoder_decode(ImageDecoder decoder, u32 frame_index) raises

decoder.decode({frameIndex}): the frame wrapped as a VideoFrame (the engine wraps it in the ImageDecodeResult and the promise). Range when frameIndex is past the frame count, Encoding when the image cannot be decoded, Invalid_State when the decoder is closed.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ImageDecoder_decode :: proc(c: ^Call, decoder: Api_ImageDecoder, frame_index: u32) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#ImageDecoder_reset

void ImageDecoder_reset(ImageDecoder decoder)

decoder.reset() / close().

Host: ImageDecoder_reset :: proc(c: ^Call, decoder: Api_ImageDecoder)

#ImageDecoder_close

void ImageDecoder_close(ImageDecoder decoder)

Host: ImageDecoder_close :: proc(c: ^Call, decoder: Api_ImageDecoder)

ImageTrackList ImageDecoder_tracks(ImageDecoder decoder)

decoder.tracks: the ImageTrackList (made on first access).
